# Implementation and verification status

## Implemented

- Scene-first primary navigation and a single resolved target for canvas, DNA,
  breadcrumb and scoped notes; searchable names and IDs; Back/Forward history
- Existing-instance browsing separate from object creation; instance/definition
  round trips; source placements, new draft references and spawn rules separated
- One immutable submission constructor, mandatory complete preview, exact-body
  confirmation, net-content diff and no-op rejection, orphan-note reassociation
- Content/destination/baseline changes require review; theme/navigation do not
- Existing v1 recovery/idempotency preserved; v2 is explicitly negotiated
- Read-only GM readiness, server-owned reviewed mappings, bounded GM routing,
  exactly-six-field feedback and distinct stage confirmations
- Formal result evidence import and layered delivery/turn/item/verification/human
  reporting, without modifying browser drafts or certifying narrative claims

## What the hosted Site does

The original Site keeps its owner-private access policy. Its clearly labeled
browser-local demo stores notes and simulated receipts in that browser. It has
no model calls, no live local bridge connection, no Godot writeback and no true
formal GM check run. Demo success only means that demo handling finished.

## What must be established locally

The source package includes the loopback Python bridge. Real execution requires
an existing matching idle Codex thread, matching source baseline, exact reviewed
GM skill/tool versions, available runtime skills/capabilities, and a server-owned
explicit target map. Unsupported or unknown mappings fail closed. The original
GM PLAN/GAP and its confirmation requirements remain authoritative.

The delivered adapter is not a demonstration that a live Codex/GM/Godot cycle ran.
This task has no bound real project thread. Live model delivery, game edits,
engine execution, platform/experience evidence and real human confirmation were
not performed. Tests use isolated fixtures/mocks and never synthesize human
acceptance or TTY input.

## Rendered browser limitation

A normal local preview was attempted using the assistant's cloud browser. It
returned `net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` for the execution workspace loopback URL.
The environment is portable, without managed preview or supported forwarding.
An elevated readiness request also encountered an infrastructure `bwrap` mount
error. These limits were not bypassed. jsdom coverage is not a rendered desktop,
mobile, visual, accessibility or physical-device certification. No screenshots
were fabricated.

## Result interpretation

Receipt acceptance, transport delivery and Codex turn completion are distinct
from item implementation and formal verification. A changed file or a previously
verified PLAN task does not by itself establish that a new request was fulfilled.
Independently validated formal evidence can upgrade global-run verification. Per-item implementation and verification remain BLOCKED without request-specific semantic and target/task/assertion coverage evidence. An unrelated checksum-valid log cannot mark an item PASS.
Source refresh/re-extraction never silently replaces newer local drafts.
